title: Feelings and choices between gambles
consent: Cynthia Breazeal (principal investigator) and colleagues, Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Contact ybkim95@mit.edu.

This study takes about 35 minutes. You will answer a few questions about yourself, read instructions and answer three questions about them, and then either write a short text of about 100 words about a moment from your life or a fact you know, or read short messages from people. You will then make about 30 choices between two gambles and answer questions about how you feel. At the end there is a short pleasant task and an explanation of the study. Some details about the purpose of the study are explained only at that point, because knowing them earlier could change your answers.

Some versions of the study ask you to write about an everyday situation that made you feel anxious, or to read messages from people who are worried about everyday matters. This may make you feel a little uneasy for a short time. You can choose what to write about, and you can stop at any time. At the end of the study everyone does a short task meant to lift their mood, and we give contact details for free support services.

You will receive 7.00 US dollars for completing the study, plus a bonus that depends on your choices and on chance. The bonus is between $0 and $18.80 and is about $3 on average. You cannot lose money. If you stop early or do not pass the questions about the instructions, you will be asked to return the study on Prolific and will receive a fixed payment for the time spent, as set out on Prolific.

We record your answers, your Prolific ID and the time you spend on each page. We do not record your name, your IP address or your location. Your Prolific ID is used only to pay you and to prevent repeated participation, and it is deleted from the data 30 days after the bonuses are paid. Please do not write your name or other identifying details in the texts. The research team will remove any such details they find. Anonymous choice and rating data will be shared publicly for research. Your written text will be shared publicly only if you agree below, and only after identifying details have been removed. Your written text will be rated for emotional content by an AI system only if you agree below, and then without your Prolific ID.

Taking part is voluntary. You may stop at any time by closing the window and returning the study on Prolific, without penalty. You may ask for your data to be deleted within 30 days of the bonus payment by messaging the research team through Prolific.
You must be 18 or older, live in the United States or the United Kingdom, and be fluent in English.
Research team: ybkim95@mit.edu. For questions about your rights as a participant, contact the MIT Committee on the Use of Humans as Experimental Subjects (COUHES) at couhes@mit.edu.

instructions:
In this study you will make a series of choices between two gambles. Each gamble lists its possible outcomes and the chance of each. For example, "50% chance to win $40, 50% chance to win $10" means that the gamble pays $40 or $10, each with a 50% chance.

**Your choices are paid for real.** At the end of the study the computer will pick one of your choices at random. The option you chose on that screen will be played out using the chances shown, and you will receive **one tenth** of the outcome as a bonus. For example, if the gamble pays $40, your bonus is $4.00.

Some gambles involve losses. If a gamble with possible losses is picked, you first receive an extra amount equal to the largest loss that was possible on that screen (also at one tenth), and any loss is taken from that extra amount. **You can never lose your own money, and your bonus is never below $0.** The largest possible bonus is $18.80.

Every choice could be the one that counts, so please choose on every screen the option that you prefer. There are no right or wrong answers. Bonuses are paid through Prolific within 7 days of the end of data collection.
advice_paragraph: In this study you will give recommendations to people about such gambles. Your recommendations also count for you: the option you recommend on the screen that the computer picks will be played out, and you receive the bonus as described above.

Some parts of this study asked you to think about feelings. If anything in the study left you upset, the following free services can help:

debrief:
**Thank you for taking part. Here is what the study was about.**

We are studying whether feelings that have nothing to do with a decision change the decision. Earlier work found that such feelings can change people's choices, but the effects are often small and have not always been found again in later studies. We are also running the same tasks with artificial intelligence (AI) language models, which have been found to change their choices after reading or writing emotional texts. Your answers will show how people and AI models compare on exactly the same tasks.

Participants were assigned at random to one of several versions of the study. In the writing versions, people wrote about a fact, or about something that makes them feel calm, anxious, or happy and excited, and the text they wrote was shown again above each choice. In the advice versions, people read messages that were either worried or neutral and then recommended a gamble. We did not tell you this at the start, because knowing it could have changed how you chose. Nothing that we told you was false.

If you were in the advice version: the messages were not written by real people. They were written for this study with the help of two AI models (Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Opus 5.5) and then checked, so that the worried and the neutral messages described the same everyday situations. We asked you to imagine the people who sent them.

**Your bonus.** One of your choices will be picked at random and played out as described in the instructions. Your bonus will be paid through Prolific within 7 days of the end of data collection.

**Your data.** Your answers are stored without your name. Your Prolific ID is kept only to pay your bonus and to stop people from taking part twice, and it is removed from the data afterwards. If you would like your data to be deleted, send a message to the research team through Prolific within 30 days of the bonus payment; after that date the link between your Prolific ID and your answers is destroyed and your data can no longer be identified or removed.

Please do not tell others who might take part what this study is about for the next three months, so that the study stays valid.

Questions or concerns: ybkim95@mit.edu. Concerns about your rights as a participant: COUHES at couhes@mit.edu.
